university_address_note: LODES places 28,766 of the city's 32,738 education jobs (essentially all of U-M's non-hospital staff; OBP reports 33,291 campus staff) in this one block, the employer's reported address, not where people work. prepare moves them onto academic buildings in proportion to footprint area. Found by listing the blocks with the most education jobs; re-check if the LODES year changes.
